answer_1.quote: AnGFT aims to maintain robust roleplaying capabilities while effectively enhancing the performance of RPCAs in role-related professional domains.
answer_1.outputs: role-playing conversational responses in professional domains

answer_2.quote: we employ the GPT-4 to evaluate the model's performance in role-specific professional fields across four dimensions.

answer_3.quote: we have employed Large Language Models (LLMs) as a Judge Model (JM) to evaluate the more professionally competent response.

answer_4.quote: We report the Cohen's Kappa values for these metrics, derived from independent evaluations of 100 samples by experts from various professional fields.
answer_4.guideline: experts evaluated responses based on four dimensions: Response Helpfulness, Response Thoroughness, Response Credibility, and Response Feasibility.
